052  /**
053   * This is a cryptic test. It is checking that we don't include a fake cell. See HBASE-16074 for
054   * background.
055   */
056  @Test
057  public void testNeverIncludeFakeCell() throws IOException {
058    long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
059    // Do with fam2 which has a col2 qualifier.
060    UserScanQueryMatcher qm = UserScanQueryMatcher.create(scan,
061      new ScanInfo(this.conf, fam2, 10, 1, ttl, KeepDeletedCells.FALSE,
062        HConstants.DEFAULT_BLOCKSIZE, 0, rowComparator, false),
063      get.getFamilyMap().get(fam2), now - ttl, now, null);
064    ExtendedCell kv = new KeyValue(row1, fam2, col2, 1, data);
065    ExtendedCell cell = PrivateCellUtil.createLastOnRowCol(kv);
066    qm.setToNewRow(kv);
067    MatchCode code = qm.match(cell);
068    assertFalse(code.compareTo(MatchCode.SEEK_NEXT_COL) != 0);
069  }

293  /**
294   * Here is the unit test for UserScanQueryMatcher#mergeFilterResponse, when the number of cells
295   * exceed the versions requested in scan, we should return SEEK_NEXT_COL, but if current match
296   * code is INCLUDE_AND_SEEK_NEXT_ROW, we can optimize to choose the max step between SEEK_NEXT_COL
297   * and INCLUDE_AND_SEEK_NEXT_ROW, which is SEEK_NEXT_ROW. <br/>
298   */
299  @Test
300  public void testMergeFilterResponseCase1() throws IOException {
301    List<MatchCode> expected = new ArrayList<>();
302    expected.add(MatchCode.INCLUDE);
303    expected.add(MatchCode.INCLUDE);
304    expected.add(MatchCode.SEEK_NEXT_ROW);
305
306    Scan scanWithFilter = new Scan(scan).setFilter(new AlwaysIncludeFilter()).readVersions(2);
307
308    long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
309    // scan with column 2,4,5, the family with maxVersion = 3
310    UserScanQueryMatcher qm = UserScanQueryMatcher.create(
311      scanWithFilter, new ScanInfo(this.conf, fam2, 0, 3, ttl, KeepDeletedCells.FALSE,
312        HConstants.DEFAULT_BLOCKSIZE, 0, rowComparator, false),
313      get.getFamilyMap().get(fam2), now - ttl, now, null);
314
315    List<KeyValue> memstore = new ArrayList<>();
316    memstore.add(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col5, 1, data)); // match code will be INCLUDE
317    memstore.add(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col5, 2, data)); // match code will be INCLUDE
318
319    // match code will be SEEK_NEXT_ROW , which is max(INCLUDE_AND_SEEK_NEXT_ROW, SEEK_NEXT_COL).
320    memstore.add(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col5, 3, data));
321
322    KeyValue k = memstore.get(0);
323    qm.setToNewRow(k);
324
325    for (int i = 0; i < memstore.size(); i++) {
326      assertEquals(expected.get(i), qm.match(memstore.get(i)));
327    }
328
329    scanWithFilter = new Scan(scan).setFilter(new AlwaysIncludeFilter()).readVersions(1);
330    qm = UserScanQueryMatcher.create(
331      scanWithFilter, new ScanInfo(this.conf, fam2, 0, 2, ttl, KeepDeletedCells.FALSE,
332        HConstants.DEFAULT_BLOCKSIZE, 0, rowComparator, false),
333      get.getFamilyMap().get(fam2), now - ttl, now, null);
334
335    List<KeyValue> memstore2 = new ArrayList<>();
336    memstore2.add(new KeyValue(row2, fam1, col2, 1, data)); // match code will be INCLUDE
337    // match code will be SEEK_NEXT_COL, which is max(INCLUDE_AND_SEEK_NEXT_COL, SEEK_NEXT_COL).
338    memstore2.add(new KeyValue(row2, fam1, col2, 2, data));
339
340    k = memstore2.get(0);
341    qm.setToNewRow(k);
342
343    assertEquals(MatchCode.INCLUDE, qm.match(memstore2.get(0)));
344    assertEquals(MatchCode.SEEK_NEXT_COL, qm.match(memstore2.get(1)));
345  }

347  /**
348   * Here is the unit test for UserScanQueryMatcher#mergeFilterResponse: the match code may be
349   * changed to SEEK_NEXT_COL or INCLUDE_AND_SEEK_NEXT_COL after merging with filterResponse, even
350   * if the passed match code is neither SEEK_NEXT_COL nor INCLUDE_AND_SEEK_NEXT_COL. In that case,
351   * we need to make sure that the ColumnTracker has been switched to the next column. <br/>
352   * An effective test way is: we only need to check the cell from getKeyForNextColumn(). because
353   * that as long as the UserScanQueryMatcher returns SEEK_NEXT_COL or INCLUDE_AND_SEEK_NEXT_COL,
354   * UserScanQueryMatcher#getKeyForNextColumn should return an cell whose column is larger than the
355   * current cell's.
356   */
357  @Test
358  public void testMergeFilterResponseCase2() throws Exception {
359    List<MatchCode> expected = new ArrayList<>();
360    expected.add(ScanQueryMatcher.MatchCode.INCLUDE);
361    expected.add(ScanQueryMatcher.MatchCode.INCLUDE);
362    expected.add(ScanQueryMatcher.MatchCode.INCLUDE);
363    expected.add(ScanQueryMatcher.MatchCode.SEEK_NEXT_COL);
364
365    Scan scanWithFilter = new Scan(scan).setFilter(new AlwaysIncludeFilter()).readVersions(3);
366
367    long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
368
369    // scan with column 2,4,5, the family with maxVersion = 5
370    UserScanQueryMatcher qm = UserScanQueryMatcher.create(
371      scanWithFilter, new ScanInfo(this.conf, fam2, 0, 5, ttl, KeepDeletedCells.FALSE,
372        HConstants.DEFAULT_BLOCKSIZE, 0, rowComparator, false),
373      get.getFamilyMap().get(fam2), now - ttl, now, null);
374
375    List<KeyValue> memstore = new ArrayList<>();
376
377    memstore.add(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col2, 1, data)); // match code will be INCLUDE
378    memstore.add(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col2, 2, data)); // match code will be INCLUDE
379    memstore.add(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col2, 3, data)); // match code will be INCLUDE
380    memstore.add(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col2, 4, data)); // match code will be SEEK_NEXT_COL
381
382    KeyValue k = memstore.get(0);
383    qm.setToNewRow(k);
384
385    for (int i = 0; i < memstore.size(); i++) {
386      assertEquals(expected.get(i), qm.match(memstore.get(i)));
387    }
388
389    // For last cell, the query matcher will return SEEK_NEXT_COL, and the
390    // ColumnTracker will skip to the next column, which is col4.
391    ExtendedCell lastCell = memstore.get(memstore.size() - 1);
392    Cell nextCell = qm.getKeyForNextColumn(lastCell);
393    assertArrayEquals(nextCell.getQualifierArray(), col4);
394  }

396  /**
397   * After enough consecutive range delete markers, the matcher should switch from SKIP to
398   * SEEK_NEXT_COL. Point deletes and KEEP_DELETED_CELLS always SKIP.
399   */
400  @Test
401  public void testSeekOnRangeDelete() throws IOException {
402    int n = NormalUserScanQueryMatcher.SEEK_ON_DELETE_MARKER_THRESHOLD;
403
404    // DeleteColumn: first N-1 SKIP, N-th triggers SEEK_NEXT_COL
405    assertSeekAfterThreshold(KeepDeletedCells.FALSE, Type.DeleteColumn, n);
406
407    // DeleteFamily: same threshold behavior
408    assertSeekAfterThreshold(KeepDeletedCells.FALSE, Type.DeleteFamily, n);
409
410    // Delete (version): always SKIP (point delete, not range)
411    assertAllSkip(KeepDeletedCells.FALSE, Type.Delete, n + 1);
412
413    // KEEP_DELETED_CELLS=TRUE: always SKIP
414    assertAllSkip(KeepDeletedCells.TRUE, Type.DeleteColumn, n + 1);
415  }

417  /**
418   * DeleteColumn with empty qualifier must not cause seeking past a subsequent DeleteFamily.
419   * DeleteFamily masks all columns, so it must be tracked by the delete tracker.
420   */
421  @Test
422  public void testDeleteColumnEmptyQualifierDoesNotSkipDeleteFamily() throws IOException {
423    long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
424    byte[] e = HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY;
425    UserScanQueryMatcher qm = UserScanQueryMatcher.create(scan, new ScanInfo(this.conf, fam1, 0, 1,
426      ttl, KeepDeletedCells.FALSE, HConstants.DEFAULT_BLOCKSIZE, 0, rowComparator, false), null,
427      now - ttl, now, null);
428
429    int n = NormalUserScanQueryMatcher.SEEK_ON_DELETE_MARKER_THRESHOLD;
430    // Feed DCs with empty qualifier past the threshold, then a DF.
431    // The DF must NOT be seeked past -- it must be SKIP'd so the tracker picks it up.
432    qm.setToNewRow(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, e, now, Type.DeleteColumn));
433    for (int i = 0; i < n + 1; i++) {
434      // Empty qualifier DCs should never trigger seek, regardless of threshold
435      assertEquals(MatchCode.SKIP,
436        qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, e, now - i, Type.DeleteColumn)), "DC at i=" + i);
437    }
438    KeyValue df = new KeyValue(row1, fam1, e, now - n - 1, Type.DeleteFamily);
439    KeyValue put = new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col1, now - n - 1, Type.Put, data);
440    // DF must be processed (SKIP), not seeked past
441    assertEquals(MatchCode.SKIP, qm.match(df));
442    // Put in col1 at t=now-3 should be masked by DF@t=now-3
443    MatchCode putCode = qm.match(put);
444    assertEquals(MatchCode.SEEK_NEXT_COL, putCode);
445  }

447  /**
448   * DeleteColumn markers for different qualifiers should not accumulate the seek counter. Only
449   * consecutive markers for the same qualifier should trigger seeking.
450   */
451  @Test
452  public void testDeleteColumnDifferentQualifiersDoNotSeek() throws IOException {
453    long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
454    UserScanQueryMatcher qm = UserScanQueryMatcher.create(scan, new ScanInfo(this.conf, fam1, 0, 1,
455      ttl, KeepDeletedCells.FALSE, HConstants.DEFAULT_BLOCKSIZE, 0, rowComparator, false), null,
456      now - ttl, now, null);
457
458    // DCs for different qualifiers: counter resets on qualifier change, never seeks
459    qm.setToNewRow(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col1, now, Type.DeleteColumn));
460    assertEquals(MatchCode.SKIP, qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col1, now, Type.DeleteColumn)));
461    assertEquals(MatchCode.SKIP,
462      qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col2, now - 1, Type.DeleteColumn)));
463    assertEquals(MatchCode.SKIP,
464      qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col3, now - 2, Type.DeleteColumn)));
465    assertEquals(MatchCode.SKIP,
466      qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col4, now - 3, Type.DeleteColumn)));
467    assertEquals(MatchCode.SKIP,
468      qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col5, now - 4, Type.DeleteColumn)));
469  }

471  /**
472   * Delete markers outside the scan's time range (includeDeleteMarker=false) should still
473   * accumulate the seek counter and trigger SEEK_NEXT_COL after the threshold.
474   */
475  @Test
476  public void testSeekOnRangeDeleteOutsideTimeRange() throws IOException {
477    long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
478    long futureTs = now + 1_000_000;
479    Scan scanWithTimeRange = new Scan(scan).setTimeRange(futureTs, Long.MAX_VALUE);
480
481    UserScanQueryMatcher qm = UserScanQueryMatcher.create(scanWithTimeRange,
482      new ScanInfo(this.conf, fam1, 0, 1, ttl, KeepDeletedCells.FALSE, HConstants.DEFAULT_BLOCKSIZE,
483        0, rowComparator, false),
484      null, now - ttl, now, null);
485
486    int n = NormalUserScanQueryMatcher.SEEK_ON_DELETE_MARKER_THRESHOLD;
487    qm.setToNewRow(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col1, now, Type.DeleteColumn));
488    // All DCs have timestamps below the time range, so includeDeleteMarker is false.
489    // The seek counter should still accumulate.
490    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
491      assertEquals(MatchCode.SKIP,
492        qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col1, now - i, Type.DeleteColumn)), "DC at i=" + i);
493    }
494    assertEquals(MatchCode.SEEK_NEXT_COL,
495      qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, col1, now - n + 1, Type.DeleteColumn)));
496  }

498  private UserScanQueryMatcher createDeleteMatcher(KeepDeletedCells keepDeletedCells)
499    throws IOException {
500    long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
501    return UserScanQueryMatcher.create(scan, new ScanInfo(this.conf, fam1, 0, 1, ttl,
502      keepDeletedCells, HConstants.DEFAULT_BLOCKSIZE, 0, rowComparator, false), null, now - ttl,
503      now, null);
504  }

506  /** First n-1 markers SKIP, n-th triggers SEEK_NEXT_COL. */
507  private void assertSeekAfterThreshold(KeepDeletedCells keepDeletedCells, Type type, int n)
508    throws IOException {
509    long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
510    UserScanQueryMatcher qm = createDeleteMatcher(keepDeletedCells);
511    boolean familyLevel = type == Type.DeleteFamily || type == Type.DeleteFamilyVersion;
512    byte[] qual = familyLevel ? HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY : col1;
513    qm.setToNewRow(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, qual, now, type));
514    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
515      assertEquals(MatchCode.SKIP, qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, qual, now - i, type)),
516        "Mismatch at index " + i);
517    }
518    assertEquals(MatchCode.SEEK_NEXT_COL,
519      qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, qual, now - n + 1, type)),
520      "Expected SEEK_NEXT_COL at index " + (n - 1));
521  }
522
523  /** All markers should SKIP regardless of count. */
524  private void assertAllSkip(KeepDeletedCells keepDeletedCells, Type type, int count)
525    throws IOException {
526    long now = EnvironmentEdgeManager.currentTime();
527    UserScanQueryMatcher qm = createDeleteMatcher(keepDeletedCells);
528    boolean familyLevel = type == Type.DeleteFamily || type == Type.DeleteFamilyVersion;
529    byte[] qual = familyLevel ? HConstants.EMPTY_BYTE_ARRAY : col1;
530    qm.setToNewRow(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, qual, now, type));
531    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
532      assertEquals(MatchCode.SKIP, qm.match(new KeyValue(row1, fam1, qual, now - i, type)),
533        "Mismatch at index " + i);
534    }
535  }
536}
